steps.npc: I do not thinke thou understand the depths of the darkness you have unleashed upon the world. To dub it in such a scintillant manner is offensive to mine being.

steps.player: So why are you following me around?

steps.npc: Dark forces of which ye know nought have deemed that this is my geas.
Sighs* Nae. But thine is well and truly cooked.
I am spawned of darkness. I am filled with darkness. I am darkness incarnate and to darkness I will return.
Knowest thou not of the cursed place? Knowest thou not about the future yet to befall your puny race?

steps.player: Oh yes, I've heard that before.

steps.npc: Then it is good that ye can laugh in the face of the end.

steps.player: The end has a face? Which end?

steps.npc: Sighs* The darkness giveth, and the darkness taketh.

options.text: What can you do for me?

steps.npc: Nothing. Ye are already tainted in my sight by the acts of light. However there may be some hope for you if you continue to aid the darkness.

steps.player: I do have a lantern around here somewhere.

steps.npc: Do not bring that foul and repellant thing near mine self.

using-items-on-skotos-book-of-darkness.npc: A book of darkness? I don't usually read, but that seems like a good book!

using-items-on-skotos-light-sources.npc: I told thee to keep thy filthy light away from me!
